name: unequal_budget

oracle.source: .kiro/specs/ascension-trials-scalable-two-player-analysis (VS3 Task 4; REQ-1/REQ-2/REQ-3/REQ-7.2). Matrix, per-side collapse and per-side canonical mixtures hand-derived from the rules of configs/toy/asym_two_trial.json.

provenance: VS3 unequal-state fixture ASYM-1 (REQ-9.4 provenance discipline: every expected value below is derived by hand from the rules, not reverse-engineered from engine output). Config configs/toy/asym_two_trial.json: one fungible domain, two Trials (trial_a, trial_b) each first=2/second=0, shared_full ties, trial tiebreak total_power then shared, optional allocation with residue, no final tiebreak (so Recognition-Point ties resolve shared). Player A holds fungible power 2, player B power 1 -> A has 6 legal allocations (distributions of up to 2 units over 2 Trials: C(4,2)=6), B has 3 (C(3,2)=3), a genuinely rectangular 6x3 game. Per-Trial award to A given A places a and B places b units on a Trial: 0 if a=0; else 2 if b=0 or a>b (sole first) or a=b>=1 (shared_full, both bank 2); 0 if a<b. Recognition Points sum the two Trials; higher RP wins (win +1/-1), equal RP -> shared final (win 0, margin 0). Hand-derivation: A=(1,1) enters both Trials, so against B's single unit it banks 4 vs at most 2 and wins every column -> row (1,1) has win row all +1 and is the pure maximin strategy for both the win game (value +1) and the margin game (value +2, its worst column giving margin 2). The win game's column player is indifferent (A=(1,1) scores +1 against every column), so the canonical column mixture is uniform and E^0.01 includes all three columns; the margin game's column player must avoid the empty column B=(0,0) (which concedes margin 4) and is indifferent between the two one-unit columns, giving the canonical margin column mixture [0, 1/2, 1/2]. Strict dominance removes only A=(0,0) (dominated by (1,1)), so A's reasonable set has 5 members and B's has 3. No two strategies share a full behaviour signature on either side, so the per-side collapse merges nothing (6 row classes, 3 column classes). Counterability (G4/G5) is an equal-state gate and is not_applicable to this unequal state (REQ-3.3). Trial-shared rate: over the 18 ordered pairs x 2 Trials, a Trial is shared only when A and B place equal >=1 units on it -> pairs (A=(1,0),B=(1,0)) [trial_a], (A=(0,1),B=(0,1)) [trial_b], (A=(1,1),B=(1,0)) [trial_a], (A=(1,1),B=(0,1)) [trial_b] = 4 shared slots / 36 = 1/9. Final-tie pairs = 7/18. No cell is decided by a final tiebreak (chain-decided rate 0). Reward concentration (Herfindahl of first rewards {2,2}) = 0.5; A's dead power = 0 (both Trials accept a lone fungible unit).

column_mixture.comment: avoid empty column, indifferent between one-unit columns
